command:
if [ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id ]; then printf 'source=linux-boot-id
'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; elif command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && sysctl -n kern.boottime >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'source=bsd-boottime
'; sysctl -n kern.boottime; else printf '%s
' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: boot-identity'; fi
printf 'node=%s\naddress=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; uname -srmo 2>/dev/null || uname -a; if [ -r /etc/os-release ]; then sed -n '1,40p' /etc/os-release; fi
if [ -d /tmp ]; then find /tmp -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -print 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort | head -n 500; else printf '%s\n' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: /tmp'; fi
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null; else printf '%s\n' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: systemctl'; fi

if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -lntupH 2>/dev/null; elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then netstat -lntup 2>/dev/null; else printf '%s\n' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: sockets'; fi | head -n 300

if command -v dpkg >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'manager=dpkg
'; dpkg --audit; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'manager=dnf
'; dnf -q check; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'manager=yum
'; yum -q check; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'manager=apk
'; apk audit --system 2>/dev/null; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'manager=pacman
'; pacman -Dk; else printf '%s
' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: package-manager-health'; fi

if [ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id ]; then printf 'source=linux-boot-id
'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; elif command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && sysctl -n kern.boottime >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'source=bsd-boottime
'; sysctl -n kern.boottime; else printf '%s
' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: boot-identity'; fi
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null; else printf '%s\n' '__HARBOR_ANTRIEB_UNSUPPORTED__: systemctl'; fi
printf 'node=%s\naddress=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; uname -srmo 2>/dev/null || uname -a; if [ -r /etc/os-release ]; then sed -n '1,40p' /etc/os-release; fi
